title: The Italian Municipality Equitable and Sustainable Well-being Index (MESWI)
abstract: arXiv:2608.26426v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops the Municipal Equitable and Sustainable Well-being Index (MESWI) for all Italian municipalities, extending the 12-domain BES framework to the local level through 49 indicators. Results reveal substantial territorial heterogeneity that regional and provincial statistics may conceal. The North-South divide remains the dominant geographical pattern and is considerably stronger than the difference between inner and non-inner areas. At the same time, municipalities within the same regions and territorial categories display markedly different well-being profiles. Remoteness is associated with weaker services and socio-economic opportunities but also with stronger environmental performance. The MESWI provides a fine-grained picture of multidimensional well-being and a potential information base for the programming, monitoring and evaluation of place-based policies.

translated_title: 意大利市政公平与可持续福祉指数（MESWI）
translated_abstract: 本文为所有意大利市政开发了市政公平与可持续福祉指数（MESWI），通过49项指标将12个领域的BES框架扩展至地方层面。结果显示，区域和省级统计可能掩盖的显著地域异质性。南北分歧仍是主导的地理模式，且比内部与非内部区域之间的差异更为显著。同时，同一地区和地域类别内的市政表现出明显不同的福祉特征。偏远地区与较弱的服务和社会经济机会相关，但环境表现更优。MESWI提供了多维福祉的精细图景，并为基于地方的政策规划、监测和评估提供了潜在的信息基础。
tldr: 本文提出了一种覆盖意大利所有市政的49项指标多维福祉指数（MESWI），揭示了远超区域统计的南北差异和地域内异质性，为地方政策制定提供了精细数据支持。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the MESWI, a 49-indicator multidimensional well-being index for all Italian municipalities, revealing stark North-South and intra-regional disparities beyond regional statistics, offering a granular basis for place-based policy.
